title: ACHIRI — /achiri-bot-setup: BotFather setup guide (unblock ACHIRI_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN)
description: The primary blocker for Achiri alpha launch is ACHIRI_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN not set. Create /achiri-bot-setup Telegram command that shows step-by-step: 1) Message @BotFather /newbot, 2) Set name + username, 3) Copy token to .env, 4) Set bot description and profile pic. Operator can run this from their phone without SSH.
